capabilities: Search the vault by keyword or meaning through a local service
Surface notes related to the active note
Expose vault retrieval to agents over MCP
Initialize, refresh, and rebuild the local index from a side panel
Open search result notes directly in Obsidian
disambiguation: Not an AI chat plugin or a standalone search engine; it is a UI and lifecycle wrapper around the separate obsidian-kb CLI.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian Mobile is unsupported because the plugin spawns a local process); the obsidian-kb CLI must be installed separately; BRAT installation is supported; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it as a bridge: agents need more than raw file access, and the workflow follows the LLM Wiki pattern where Obsidian is the human-facing workspace and agents handle search and maintenance.
problem: AI agents need a reliable local way to search and inspect a vault, and Obsidian has no built-in retrieval layer that keeps notes off hosted knowledge services.

relations.evidence: It is an Obsidian UI and lifecycle wrapper around the separate obsidian-kb CLI
turns your Obsidian vault into a private local retrieval layer for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode

summary: Local retrieval layer that wraps the obsidian-kb CLI to add semantic search, related notes, and MCP access for AI agents.
